text: よんで　おいて　にげるな！

patterns.name: 〜ておいて
patterns.explanation: ておいて after a verb, followed by something that goes against it, says 'after having done that, you then do this', as a complaint. よんで　おいて = 'after calling me over'.

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after the plain form of a verb is a rough 'don't do it'. にげるな = 'don't run away'.
